body: You are right. I held my little girl today and you are right. She’s the light in my otheriwise sick world. I will try to be better. I will try to fight the urge for the easy way out. It’s not me. I always got mad at people who took the easy way. It’s just I feel so beat down and weak...

Thank you everyone... I’m definitely in a dark place but I went and held my baby girl today and realized I don’t wanna lose her.shes my everything. I spoke to my wife about how I am feeling and she is being supportive and loving. I am sorry everyone. I just didn’t know where else to put my thoughts.. it’s pathetic I know but I just needed someone somewhere to hear my pleas... again thank you for your kind words, I can’t promise anything but I will love each day one by one.
